name: Find tenders, grants and advertised work that fit the business
summary: Finds tenders, grants and advertised work that fit the business. Reads the alert emails that tender and grant portals send to the business's mailbox, logs each new opportunity to a register, and drafts a digest of the ones a person judges a fit for approval. Crons read and draft; a person approves every send.

covered_by.source-scan: scan (reads the alerts folder each hour)
covered_by.read-brief: scan (the alert preview); the full notice is opened by a person
covered_by.record-keeping: log (one row per new opportunity in the register)
covered_by.send-digest: digest (draft in the mailbox, send queued for approval)

crons.name: scan
crons.summary: Each hour: read the alert emails in the folder and store the ones not seen before.

crons.name: log
crons.summary: Log each new opportunity as a row in the register workbook.

crons.name: digest
crons.summary: Each morning in eastern Australia (21:00 UTC): draft the digest of opportunities judged a fit and queue its send for approval.

draft_ops_note: Every draft operation reaches nobody outside the business: a read of the alerts folder, a row in the register workbook, and a digest draft in the business's own mailbox. The send of that digest is a live operation and waits for a person. The register row and the draft are writes, so the deploy needs KIT_ALLOW_WRITES=1.

microsoft-365.covers: alert emails read from a mail folder, register rows in an Excel table, the digest draft and its approved send

gaps: Tender and grant portals (AusTender, state tender sites, grant finders): no portal operation is mapped in the kit. The scan reads the alert emails those portals send. The owner sets up each alert on the portal.
EstimateOne: the platform pages show a subcontractor source scan, but its operations are not mapped in the kit. Not built.
BuiltGrid: its pages describe builders inviting trades to quote, with no trade-side search, alerts or fit check. Not built.
Full notice text: the alert list returns the Outlook preview (about 255 characters). The kit maps no full-message read, so closing dates and scope beyond the preview need a person to open the email.
Grants: no grant feed is built. Grant alerts that land in the same mailbox are judged by the same fit check.
Fit judgment is an agent step. The crons do not filter by trade, value or location; the verdicts come from the skill.
Eligibility checks (licences, insurance, prequalification): no platform in the pages read describes them. They stay with the owner.
Pricing, bid preparation, partner search, submission and award follow-up: these belong to the quoting workflow and are not covered here.
Live behaviour is unverified: no Microsoft 365 account has run these crons.
